create_Scannet_Evaluator: create a Scannet_Evaluator instance for semantic instance segmentation evaluation on a given dataset
run_evaluate: run evaluate on prediction and ground truth dicts to compute AP scores for semantic instance segmentation
compute_averages: compute averages from AP scores including all_AP, AP_50, AP_25 and per-class metrics
assign_instances_for_scan: assign ground truth instances to predicted masks using IoU matching for a single scan
print_results: print formatted AP, AP_50, AP_25 results per class and overall averages to a logger
